questions.q: How many triggers can a single Power Automate flow have?
options: Zero or more, depending on the connector
Exactly one
Exactly two — a start trigger and an end trigger
As many as there are actions
questions.explain: A flow is a directed sequence that always starts with exactly one trigger, followed by any number of actions.

questions.q: What becomes available to every action downstream in a flow?
options: Only the name of the trigger, not its data
The trigger's full output payload, similar to a webhook body in a handler function
Nothing — each action must re-fetch its own data independently
Only the first action's output, not the trigger's
questions.explain: The trigger's full JSON output is available to every downstream action, the same way a webhook payload is available inside an event handler.

questions.q: In the 'Add an action' pane, which category holds control-flow actions like conditions and loops?
options: AI Capabilities
By connector
Built-in tools
Favorites
questions.explain: Built-in tools is where control-flow building blocks like conditions, loops, and variables live, as opposed to connector-specific actions.

questions.q: What happens if you try to save a flow with a misconfigured action?
options: Power Automate saves it anyway and flags the error at the next run
The save is blocked and the error is shown until it's fixed
The misconfigured action is silently deleted
The flow is saved as a draft and emailed to the owner
questions.explain: Save runs a validation pass first; a flow with errors won't save until those are corrected, the same way a compiler blocks a build with a syntax error.

questions.q: Where would you look to see the full input and output of every action from a specific flow run?
options: The flow's run history
The Power Automate billing dashboard
The connector's marketplace listing
The trigger's documentation page
questions.explain: Run history logs the full input and output of every action for every run, test or production, and is the primary place to debug unexpected behavior.
